description: Na₂Li₄Mn₂C₄SO₁₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fddd space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one SO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.52 Å. Li is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.43 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.18 Å) and two longer (2.31 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.29 Å) and two longer (1.30 Å) C-O bond lengths. S is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All S-O bond lengths are 1.50 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Li, and one S atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaLi₂S trigonal pyramids.
